assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier-to-portal flow carries business-critical-data and pii.

assumptions.assumption: The portal-to-bucket flow carries business-critical-data and pii.

assumptions.assumption: The master-to-bucket flow carries business-critical-data and pii.
assumptions.basis: The load file is produced by the supplier master service for supplier data processing.

assumptions.assumption: The master-to-database flow carries business-critical-data and pii.
assumptions.basis: The flow carries supplier records.
